## Wave 5 Summary

This wave RESOLVES Conflict C2 (context §E): the `sessions/framework/phonic-exflation-equation.md` §5.3 sentence fuses **Claim A** (PROVEN, S38: "The Ordered Veil — the transit IS the physics," diabatic freeze-out, `P_exc → 1.000`, screening-vs-transit ratio `t_scr/t_transit = 814`) with **Claim B** (RETRACTED, S39: "GGE never thermalizes — full Richardson–Gaudin integrability permanence," BROKEN by a 13% non-separable density–density channel, Brody β = 0.633, `t_therm ≈ 6 M_KK⁻¹`). The document also prints `t_therm/t_Hubble ∼ 9×10⁻⁴⁸` — a **container-clock artifact** (the FRW Hubble time, exactly the external clock §6.3 forbids; the ratio is not even well-defined until the absent `t(τ)` map is closed).

C2's resolution is structurally two-layer and this wave settles both legs **independently** of the retracted integrability-permanence:

- **Dynamical leg (VOL-V1 / §W5-1)**: the relic survives because it is *frozen by diabaticity* — the crossing is 814× faster than any rearrangement channel can act. Recompute the freeze-out ratios on the SUBSTRATE clock `t_transit` (drop `t_Hubble`). Targets: `t_scr/t_transit = 814` (S38 eq_8941) and `t_therm/t_transit ≈ 5×10³` (S39 `t_therm ≈ 6 M_KK⁻¹` ÷ `dt_transit = 1.1302×10⁻³ M_KK⁻¹`). The two channel-ratios agreeing to within 1 OOM is the robustness check — the freeze-out is real regardless of which relaxation channel sets it.
- **Information-theoretic leg (HAW-V2 / §W5-2)**: the post-fold relic is a Bogoliubov *product state* — `Tr ρ² = 1` (pure), `S_ent = 0` — so there is no information loss and no Page-curve obligation. This certifies the relic's purity directly from the Bogoliubov coefficients, independent of integrability. The surviving integrability is the **pairing-channel** integrability (S39 retraction + restoration on the pairing sector; the full `D_K` dynamics is only weakly chaotic, Brody β = 0.633).

Two CC-warrant gates make the §7.1 cosmological-constant story microscopically honest: **EQUILIBRIUM-CC-WARRANT (§W5-3)** writes the explicit `dε/dq = μ ⇒ ρ_Λ = 0` equilibrium-theorem chain (the "vacuum energy test" — the framework does not inherit the 114-OOM catastrophe because the ground-state energy does not gravitate); **COMPRESSIBILITY-G-N (§W5-4)** corroborates the G6 `G_N` τ-flatness via the substrate-compressibility route (INFO). **TAU-FLOW-Q-FLOW-REGISTRY-NOTE (§W5-6)** lands the registry-hygiene clarification that E7 (τ-flow `dS/dτ>0`, geometric modulus) and S62 (q-flow `dE_ZP/dq>0`, conserved vacuum charge) are TWO DISTINCT proven theorems on two axes — the CC layer rests on the latter, not the τ-ramp. **Q-GGE-PRECISION (§W5-5)** is CONDITIONAL: it upgrades the relic charge `⟨Q⟩_GGE = 59.8` from "order tens" to a VAP/PBCS-projected quoted number, and runs ONLY IF a downstream gate registers a need for the precision (pre-registered trigger below).

**Substrate framing (whole wave)**: The Ordered Veil is the GGE relic on the substrate's OWN clock `t_transit` — a freeze-out of substrate excitations during the diabatic crossing of the van Hove fold. It is NOT reheating in a container, and the relevant clock is NOT the FRW Hubble time. The substrate IS the relic; the laboratory measures CMB acoustic signatures of it. Every gate here flows FROM `D_K` eigenvalues (BdG dispersion `ω_k`, Bogoliubov `α_k, β_k`, the (0,0)-sector BCS ladder) TOWARD the emergent observable (relic survival, purity, CC residual), never the reverse.

substitution_chain:
  required: true          # the PASS boundary S_ent < 1e-12 IS a threshold/direction claim (S_ent → 0 from above)
  content: |
    Claim: "S_ent < 1e-12 (the relic is a pure product state); equivalently Tr ρ² = 1 — direction: S_ent
            approaches its lower bound 0 from above, NOT a positive thermal entropy."

    Definition 1: Each post-fold mode k is a two-mode squeezed vacuum with Bogoliubov coefficients (α_k, β_k),
                  |α_k|² − |β_k|² = 1  [BdG normalization; s75_dimer_z2_pair_production.npz]
    Definition 2: ρ      = ⊗_k ρ_k    [the relic is a PRODUCT over modes — no inter-mode entanglement;
                  knowledge MCP ENT-39: S_ent = 0.000000 nats EXACTLY, product state]
    Definition 3: Tr ρ²  = Π_k Tr ρ_k²   [purity factorizes over a product state]
    Definition 4: S_ent  = −Tr(ρ ln ρ) = Σ_k S(ρ_k)   [von Neumann entropy is additive over a product state]

        S_ent = Σ_k 0 = 0

    Canonical form (the equivalence):
        Tr ρ² = 1   ⇔   S_ent = 0    (a state is pure ⇔ its von Neumann entropy vanishes)

    Direction:
        S_ent is bounded below by 0 (entropy is non-negative). A pure product state SATURATES that bound:
        S_ent → 0⁺. The gate's threshold S_ent < 1e-12 is the numerical realization of "saturates the lower
        bound." Any DEVIATION upward (S_ent > 1e-6, the FAIL band) would signal hidden inter-mode entanglement

        purity (Tr ρ²=1) ⇒ S_ent at its floor; loss of purity ⇒ S_ent rises off the floor.

    Counterfactual (the entropy the Ordered Veil AVOIDS):
        S_thermal = Σ_k [(1+n_k) ln(1+n_k) − n_k ln n_k] > 0  with n_k = |β_k|²   [a THERMAL relic would carry
        this strictly-positive entropy]. The product-state relic has S_ent = 0 ≪ S_thermal — the gap is the
        information the diabatic freeze-out keeps coherent (the retained squeeze phase).

    Conclusion: "Tr ρ² = 1 and S_ent = 0 (to machine ε) for the Bogoliubov product-state relic; S_ent sits at
                 its lower bound, so there is no information loss and no Page-curve obligation — the C2
                 information-theoretic leg is settled independently of integrability."   [now justified]

substitution_chain:
  required: false      # value+error-bar gate; no signed-direction claim. The "59.8 overestimates" direction

                       # The block below is the STRUCTURAL (definitional) estimator-reduction chain that
                       # applies WHEN the conditional_run_trigger fires; it is not a directional prediction.
  content: |
    Structural (definitional) chain — applies ONLY in the run-branch (conditional_run_trigger fired):

    Definition 1: |BCS⟩          = the mean-field BCS state on the (0,0) sector at the fold; it is a
                  superposition over particle-number sectors (N is NOT sharp — gauge symmetry broken)
    Definition 2: ⟨Q⟩_GGE^BCS    = ⟨BCS| N̂_pair |BCS⟩ = 59.8   [the bare BCS-projection count; canonical n_pairs]
    Definition 3: P_N            = projector onto the sharp-N pair sector   [restores the conserved-N symmetry]
    Definition 4: |PBCS_N⟩       = P_N |BCS⟩ / ‖P_N |BCS⟩‖   [particle-number-PROJECTED BCS state, PBCS]
                  |VAP_N⟩        = argmin_{|BCS(Δ)⟩} ⟨PBCS_N| Ĥ |PBCS_N⟩   [variation-AFTER-projection, VAP]

    Substitute (the projected estimator, no simplification):
        ⟨Q⟩_GGE^PBCS = ⟨PBCS_N| N̂_pair |PBCS_N⟩   (= N exactly within a sharp-N sector — the projection
                       makes the charge an eigenvalue, removing the mean-field particle-number fluctuation)

    Simplify (the error the projection removes, anchored to the ED benchmark):
        ε_proj(N) = (⟨Q⟩_GGE^PBCS − ⟨Q⟩_GGE^ED) / ⟨Q⟩_GGE^ED
        benchmark: ε_proj(N=1) = +0.97%,  ε_proj(N=2) = +0.27%   [PBCS-vs-ED, nazarewicz-collab §5.3 / Papers 03,17]

    Canonical form (what the gate quotes):
        ⟨Q⟩_GGE^PBCS = (projected charge)  ±  (benchmark-anchored projection error, ≤ 5% ceiling)
        — a quoted number replacing "order tens", with controlled regime-validity at small N.

    Structural reading (NOT a directional gate):
        The bare BCS count (59.8) and the projected count are two DIFFERENT estimators of the SAME conserved
        charge; the projected one restores the symmetry the mean-field broke. The "59.8 overestimates" fact is
        a REPORTED comparison (BCS mean-field overestimates in the ultrasmall regime: 60% gap S46, ~225×
        E_cond S63), NOT a sign the gate tests. The structural invariant the gate preserves is P_exc = 1.000
        (diabatic saturation) — untouched; only the magnitude estimator is refined.

    Conclusion: "When the trigger fires, the gate reduces ⟨Q⟩_GGE from the bare BCS projection to the
                 particle-number-projected (PBCS/VAP) estimator with a benchmark-anchored error bar; the
                 structural claim P_exc = 1 is invariant under this estimator swap."   [definitional, run-branch]
